//: One composite index: the feedback inbox lists a status tab newest-first (where('status','==',tab) + orderBy('createdAt','desc')), which Firestore cannot serve from single-field indexes. Everything else the site and its scheduled jobs query is single-field and indexed automatically: jobSubmissions by status, feedback by forwarded and by ticket, feedback ordered by createdAt, and an unfiltered collectionGroup read of users/*/alerts. If you add another query that combines a filter with an orderBy on a different field, Firestore will refuse it at runtime and print a link that generates the index — paste the result here and redeploy (firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes).
